package agent // import "github.com/mrsibe/goat/agent"

Package agent provides a provider-neutral, stateful tool-calling agent loop.

Stability: GOAT is pre-1.0 in v0.4 and may still make breaking changes. After
v1.0, the exported API follows the policy in STABILITY.md at the repository
root.

VARIABLES

var (
	// ErrMaxSteps is returned when a run exhausts its configured model turns.
	ErrMaxSteps = errors.New("agent: maximum steps reached")
	// ErrBusy is returned when a prompt, continuation, or reset races an active run.
	ErrBusy = errors.New("agent: agent is busy")
	// ErrNoMessages is returned when there is no conversation to continue.
	ErrNoMessages = errors.New("agent: no messages to continue from")
	// ErrCannotContinue is returned when the transcript tail is an assistant message
	// and no queued message can be used instead.
	ErrCannotContinue = errors.New("agent: cannot continue from an assistant message")
	// ErrAborted is returned when a provider reports an aborted turn without the
	// caller's context being canceled.
	ErrAborted = errors.New("agent: run aborted")
)

TYPES

type AfterToolCall func(context.Context, AfterToolCallContext) (*AfterToolCallResult, error)
    AfterToolCall runs after tool execution and before tool_end is emitted.

type AfterToolCallContext struct {
	AssistantMessage ai.Message
	ToolCall         ai.ToolCall
	Args             any
	Result           ToolResult
	IsError          bool
	Context          AgentContext
}
    AfterToolCallContext describes an executed tool call before finalization.

type AfterToolCallResult struct {
	Content           []ai.ContentBlock
	Details           json.RawMessage
	StructuredContent json.RawMessage
	Usage             *ai.Usage
	IsError           *bool
	Terminate         *bool
}
    AfterToolCallResult replaces selected fields of an executed tool result.

type Agent struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Agent owns a mutable transcript, tool set, model, and pending input queues.
    Only one run may be active at a time.

func New(config Config) (*Agent, error)
    New creates a stateful agent.

func (a *Agent) Abort()
    Abort cancels the active run. It is safe to call while idle.

func (a *Agent) ClearAllQueues()
    ClearAllQueues removes both queued steering and follow-up messages.

func (a *Agent) ClearFollowUpQueue()
    ClearFollowUpQueue removes queued follow-up messages.

func (a *Agent) ClearSteeringQueue()
    ClearSteeringQueue removes queued steering messages.

func (a *Agent) Continue(ctx context.Context) (Result, error)
    Continue resumes from the current transcript without adding a new user
    message.

func (a *Agent) FollowUp(message ai.Message)
    FollowUp queues a message to run after the agent would otherwise stop.

func (a *Agent) HasQueuedMessages() bool
    HasQueuedMessages reports whether either input queue is non-empty.

func (a *Agent) Messages() []ai.Message
    Messages returns a deep copy of the transcript.

func (a *Agent) PeekQueuedMessages() []ai.Message
    PeekQueuedMessages previews the next messages without consuming them.

func (a *Agent) Prompt(ctx context.Context, input string, images ...ai.ImageContent) (Result, error)
    Prompt starts a run with one user text message and optional images.

func (a *Agent) PromptMessages(ctx context.Context, messages ...ai.Message) (Result, error)
    PromptMessages starts a run with one or more messages.

func (a *Agent) Reset() error
    Reset clears the transcript and queues, restoring the initial system prompt.

func (a *Agent) Run(ctx context.Context, input string, images ...ai.ImageContent) (Result, error)
    Run is a convenience alias for Prompt.

func (a *Agent) SetMessages(messages []ai.Message)
    SetMessages replaces the transcript. The initial system prompt is not
    reinserted automatically; use Reset to restore the configured baseline.

func (a *Agent) SetModel(model ai.Model) error
    SetModel replaces the model used by future requests.

func (a *Agent) SetRequestOptions(options ai.RequestOptions)
    SetRequestOptions replaces default request options for future requests.

func (a *Agent) SetThinkingLevel(level ThinkingLevel) error
    SetThinkingLevel changes the reasoning level for future requests.

func (a *Agent) SetTools(tools []Tool) error
    SetTools replaces the executable tools for future runs.

func (a *Agent) State() State
    State returns a deep-copied snapshot of the current conversation state.

func (a *Agent) Steer(message ai.Message)
    Steer queues a message for injection after the current assistant turn.

func (a *Agent) Subscribe(listener func(Event)) func()
    Subscribe registers a synchronous event listener and returns an unsubscribe
    function. Listeners run in registration order and are part of run
    settlement.

func (a *Agent) WaitForIdle(ctx context.Context) error
    WaitForIdle waits for the active run and its event listeners to finish.

type AgentContext struct {
	Messages []ai.Message
	Tools    []Tool
}
    AgentContext is the transcript and executable tools visible to one loop.

type BeforeToolCall func(context.Context, BeforeToolCallContext) (*BeforeToolCallResult, error)
    BeforeToolCall runs after argument validation and before execution.

type BeforeToolCallContext struct {
	AssistantMessage ai.Message
	ToolCall         ai.ToolCall
	Args             any
	Context          AgentContext
}
    BeforeToolCallContext describes a validated tool call before execution.

type BeforeToolCallResult struct {
	Block     bool
	Reason    string
	Terminate bool
}
    BeforeToolCallResult can block a tool call and optionally terminate the
    batch.

type Config struct {
	Model             ai.Model
	SystemPrompt      string
	Messages          []ai.Message
	Tools             []Tool
	MaxSteps          int
	RequestOptions    ai.RequestOptions
	ToolExecution     ToolExecutionMode
	SteeringMode      QueueMode
	FollowUpMode      QueueMode
	SessionID         string
	ThinkingLevel     ThinkingLevel
	ThinkingBudgets   map[ThinkingLevel]int
	TransformMessages MessageTransformer
	BeforeToolCall    BeforeToolCall
	AfterToolCall     AfterToolCall
	PrepareRequest    PrepareRequest
	PrepareNextTurn   PrepareNextTurn
	FinishTurn        FinishTurn
}
    Config controls the reusable, stateful agent runtime.

type Event struct {
	Type          EventType    `json:"type"`
	Step          int          `json:"step,omitempty"`
	Text          string       `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Thinking      string       `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
	Message       *ai.Message  `json:"message,omitempty"`
	ToolCall      *ai.ToolCall `json:"tool_call,omitempty"`
	ToolResult    *ToolResult  `json:"tool_result,omitempty"`
	PartialResult *ToolResult  `json:"partial_result,omitempty"`
	ToolResults   []ToolResult `json:"tool_results,omitempty"`
	DurationMs    int64        `json:"duration_ms,omitempty"`
	Result        *Result      `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Err           error        `json:"-"`
	Error         string       `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
    Event is delivered synchronously while an agent run is in progress.

type EventType string
    EventType identifies a lifecycle or streaming event.

const (
	EventAgentStart    EventType = "agent_start"
	EventTurnStart     EventType = "turn_start"
	EventMessageStart  EventType = "message_start"
	EventMessageDelta  EventType = "message_delta"
	EventMessageEnd    EventType = "message_end"
	EventThinkingStart EventType = "thinking_start"
	EventThinkingDelta EventType = "thinking_delta"
	EventThinkingEnd   EventType = "thinking_end"
	EventToolStart     EventType = "tool_start"
	EventToolUpdate    EventType = "tool_update"
	EventToolEnd       EventType = "tool_end"
	EventTurnEnd       EventType = "turn_end"
	EventAgentEnd      EventType = "agent_end"
	EventAgentError    EventType = "agent_error"
)
type FinishTurn func(context.Context, TurnContext) (TurnDecision, error)
    FinishTurn runs after the assistant message and tool results are appended,
    immediately before turn_end.

type MessageTransformer func(context.Context, []ai.Message) ([]ai.Message, error)
    MessageTransformer rewrites messages immediately before a model request.
    The returned messages are request-only and do not mutate the transcript.

type ModelError struct {
	Message ai.Message
	Err     error
}
    ModelError reports a provider or stream failure after the assistant message
    has been finalized and appended to the transcript.

func (e *ModelError) Error() string

func (e *ModelError) Unwrap() error

type PrepareNextTurn func(context.Context, TurnContext) (*TurnUpdate, error)
    PrepareNextTurn runs after turn_end and before the next turn starts.

type PrepareRequest func(context.Context, PrepareRequestContext) (*RequestUpdate, error)
    PrepareRequest runs before every provider request, including the first.

type PrepareRequestContext struct {
	Context       AgentContext
	Model         ai.Model
	ThinkingLevel ThinkingLevel
}
    PrepareRequestContext describes the state immediately before a provider
    call.

type QueueMode string
    QueueMode controls how many queued messages are drained at one point.

const (
	QueueAll        QueueMode = "all"
	QueueOneAtATime QueueMode = "one-at-a-time"
)
type RequestUpdate struct {
	Context       *AgentContext
	Model         ai.Model
	ThinkingLevel *ThinkingLevel
}
    RequestUpdate replaces selected request runtime state.

type Result struct {
	Answer       string        `json:"answer"`
	Steps        int           `json:"steps"`
	StopReason   ai.StopReason `json:"stop_reason"`
	Messages     []ai.Message  `json:"messages"`
	NewMessages  []ai.Message  `json:"new_messages"`
	Usage        ai.Usage      `json:"usage"`
	ErrorMessage string        `json:"error_message,omitempty"`
}
    Result is the complete outcome of one agent run.

type State struct {
	SystemPrompt     string
	Model            ai.Model
	ThinkingLevel    ThinkingLevel
	Tools            []Tool
	Messages         []ai.Message
	IsStreaming      bool
	StreamingMessage *ai.Message
	PendingToolCalls []string
	ErrorMessage     string
}
    State is a read-only snapshot of the agent's current conversation state.

type StreamingTool interface {
	Tool
	ExecuteStream(ctx context.Context, call ai.ToolCall, update func(ToolResult)) (ToolResult, error)
}
    StreamingTool can publish partial results while it executes.

type StreamingToolFunc func(context.Context, ai.ToolCall, func(ToolResult)) (ToolResult, error)
    StreamingToolFunc is a function-backed streaming tool implementation.

type ThinkingLevel string
    ThinkingLevel is the requested reasoning level for a model turn.

const (
	ThinkingOff     ThinkingLevel = "off"
	ThinkingMinimal ThinkingLevel = "minimal"
	ThinkingLow     ThinkingLevel = "low"
	ThinkingMedium  ThinkingLevel = "medium"
	ThinkingHigh    ThinkingLevel = "high"
	ThinkingXHigh   ThinkingLevel = "xhigh"
	ThinkingMax     ThinkingLevel = "max"
)
type Tool interface {
	Spec() ToolSpec
	Execute(ctx context.Context, call ai.ToolCall) (ToolResult, error)
}
    Tool is a callable capability exposed to the model.

func NewStreamingTool(spec ToolSpec, fn StreamingToolFunc) Tool
    NewStreamingTool adapts a streaming function into a Tool.

func NewTextTool(spec ToolSpec, fn func(context.Context, ai.ToolCall) (string, error)) Tool
    NewTextTool adapts a text-returning function into a Tool.

func NewTool(spec ToolSpec, fn ToolFunc) Tool
    NewTool adapts a function into a Tool.

type ToolExecutionMode string
    ToolExecutionMode controls how tool calls in one assistant message execute.

const (
	ToolExecutionSequential ToolExecutionMode = "sequential"
	ToolExecutionParallel   ToolExecutionMode = "parallel"
)
type ToolFunc func(context.Context, ai.ToolCall) (ToolResult, error)
    ToolFunc is a function-backed tool implementation.

type ToolResult struct {
	Content           []ai.ContentBlock `json:"content"`
	Details           json.RawMessage   `json:"details,omitempty"`
	StructuredContent json.RawMessage   `json:"structured_content,omitempty"`
	Usage             *ai.Usage         `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	IsError           bool              `json:"is_error"`
	Terminate         bool              `json:"terminate,omitempty"`
}
    ToolResult is the observation returned to the model after a tool call.

func ErrorResult(text string) ToolResult
    ErrorResult creates a failed text tool result.

func TextResult(text string) ToolResult
    TextResult creates a successful text tool result.

func (r ToolResult) Text() string
    Text returns all text blocks in the result joined without separators.

type ToolSpec struct {
	Name             string
	Description      string
	Parameters       map[string]any
	Label            string
	OutputSchema     map[string]any
	ExecutionMode    ToolExecutionMode
	PrepareArguments func(json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
}
    ToolSpec is the model-facing declaration plus runtime execution hints.

type TurnContext struct {
	Message     ai.Message
	ToolResults []ai.Message
	Context     AgentContext
	NewMessages []ai.Message
}
    TurnContext describes a completed assistant turn and its tool results.

type TurnDecision string
    TurnDecision tells the loop whether to continue or stop after a turn.

const (
	TurnDefault  TurnDecision = ""
	TurnContinue TurnDecision = "continue"
	TurnEnd      TurnDecision = "end"
)
type TurnUpdate struct {
	Context       *AgentContext
	Messages      []ai.Message
	Model         ai.Model
	ThinkingLevel *ThinkingLevel
}
    TurnUpdate replaces selected state before the next turn.
